processes.role: Intern (iXp / summer / associate developer intern, on-campus)

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 2 coding problems in 45 minutes (HackerRank/SHL), usually easy-medium and story-style.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: Projects, a DSA/coding task, a classic puzzle and CS fundamentals (OOP, DBMS, OS).

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: More OOP/DBMS, sorting or linked-list code, puzzles; sometimes frontend basics.

rounds.name: HR
rounds.description: Why SAP, strengths and weaknesses, interests.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 2 coding problems (easy to hard depending on set).

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: DSA (sorting, queues via stacks, sliding window, DP) plus OOP/SQL basics and a puzzle.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: Project deep dive, schemas and SQL queries, or a technical + managerial mix.

rounds.name: HR
rounds.description: Why SAP, 5-year plan, strengths and weaknesses.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 2 easy coding problems in 45 minutes (SHL/HackerEarth), sometimes MCQs.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: Projects, simple live coding (strings/arrays), puzzles, OOP.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: DSA theory and code (binary search, sorting, BST), DBMS, OS, situational questions.

rounds.name: HR
rounds.description: Why Scholar@SAP, managing work with M.Tech, family background, scenarios.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: Core Java/Spring and 1-2 DSA problems, sometimes HLD.

rounds.name: Hiring Manager
rounds.description: Managerial/behavioral situations, past work deep dive.

rounds.name: HR
rounds.description: Offer discussion, remote vs office, collaboration.
